name: list_resources
description: List the env vars a project's code can use and the resources behind them: (1) resources CONNECTED to the project — usable as process.env.<NAME> in endpoint code now; (2) the owner's other account-level credentials — reusable, but not usable in code until connected; (3) everything Floot can add. Call it to learn what env vars exist before writing backend code, and BEFORE provisioning or requesting any credential (the owner may already have the one you need). Pass query (case-insensitive substring over names, descriptions, types, and env var names) to filter when the account has many resources. Read-only. Details: get_guides('resources').
